cover.title: GTA 6: do these first
cover.subtitle: 6 quick fixes before you play (no spoilers)

tips.title: Can't sign in?
tips.text: PSN had a big outage hours before launch. Check the official PSN or Xbox status page before you reset anything.

tips.title: Update your PS5
tips.text: Install system update 14.23: Settings > System > System Software. Reports say online features need it.

tips.title: Motion blur to 0
tips.text: GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS on every console. Turning motion blur down keeps fast turns sharp.

tips.title: Calibrate HDR
tips.text: Use the in-game HDR calibration so the Vice City sun doesn't blow out the sky.

tips.title: TV Game Mode on
tips.text: Cuts input lag, so driving and aiming feel faster.

tips.title: Save before cheats
tips.text: Cheats unlock after the main story, and using one turns off saving and trophies for that session.
